prediction_text: The horse is recoverable and will be recovered by the owner. It went westward from where it was lost (neer Henley) — the plurality of testimonies is full west — and it comes back to the owner's substance: the horse's significator hastens to join the lord of the owner's second house. It was strayed/stolen away west, not dead or irrecoverable.
timing: Day-to-week scale (a lost animal, a near matter; the significator is hastening to the conjunction): recovery soon, within days to a few weeks, from the westward direction.
basis: Lilly lost-animal rules: the horse is signified by the lord of the 12th, who is retrograde and hastening to a conjunction of the lord of the querent's 2nd house (his house of substance) — the beast returns into the owner's goods, the classic recovery testimony; the Moon locally in the 2nd and two retrograde planets near the cusp of the 2nd confirm return to the house of substance. Direction: the sign of the 12th and the sign wherein its lord is placed are both west, the plurality of testimonies full west — the horse went west. The afflicted 7th afflicts the thief/taker, not the recovery.
